Case note: CS(COMM) 1714/2025
Client: Manoj Reddy (chartered accountant, Madurai)
Opposing party: Skyline Foods Pvt Ltd
Court: Madras High Court, before Justice Lalitha Sundaram
Filed on: 05/11/2025
Claim amount: ₹5,97,00,000
Issue: geographical-indication dispute. A conflicting trademark was registered.
Advice given: File a rectification petition against the conflicting trademark.
Outcome: The conflicting trademark was removed from the register.
Recommended next step: Monitor new trademark applications.
Witness: Rekha Mittal
